inShort: A and B dink to the other's backhand in the middle and take the reply out of the air. A point won that way counts double.
rules: A and B dink at the kitchen line, each on their own half (right or left). No switching sides.
Run the pattern: dink to the other player's backhand in the middle, then take the reply out of the air.
A point won after such a volley counts 2. Any other point counts 1.
Down the line only with an advantage, such as a ball you can take out of the air. Down the line without one: point to the other player.
Dinks only. A point ends with a ball in the net, out or popped up high.
tooEasy: The first three dinks of every rally go cross-court only, so the pattern has to come later in the rally.
tooHard: Call the direction out loud before each dink: "cross", "middle" or "line".
goodLooksLike: The ball goes to the middle backhand on purpose, and the reply gets taken out of the air.
